P.text: A LaunchToken is near graduation; attacker deploys the (token, quote) UniSwapV2 pair before graduation and makes a direct deposit of 1 wei into the pair, then calls sync, bumping the pair's internal reserve of one token to 1 wei.
P.evidence_quote: Lets say that a token is near its graduation, the attacker can deploy the pair (token,quote) before the graduation.

I.text: On graduation, the contract should automatically deposit 20% of the token and all of the quoteReserve it holds into the UniSwapV2 pool via _createPairAndSwapRemaining / uniV2Router.addLiquidity, and LaunchToken cannot be transferred until graduation except by the launchpad and the GTE router.
I.evidence_quote: when LaunchToken reaches BONDING_SUPPLY on a buy, the contract should automatically deposit 20% of the token into the UniSwapV2 pool and it should also deposit all of the quoteReserve it holds.

V.text: The addLiquidity call fails because the attacker's sync leaves reserveA at 1 wei, causing the quote calculation to revert as reserveB is 0; the whole graduation transaction reverts, permanently disabling graduation, and no one can move tokens into the pair because _assertValidRecipient prevents the pair as final recipient.
V.evidence_quote: the call will fail, making the whole transaction revert, disabling graduation forever.
